lines.text: I will reflect on all You have done
and ponder Your mighty deeds.
Your way, O God, is holy.
What god is so great as our God?
You are the God who works wonders;
You display Your strength among the peoples.
With power You redeemed Your people,
the sons of Jacob and Joseph.
Selah
The waters saw You, O God;
the waters saw You and swirled;
even the depths were shaken.
The clouds poured down water;
the skies resounded with thunder;
Your arrows flashed back and forth.
Your thunder resounded in the whirlwind;
the lightning lit up the world;
the earth trembled and quaked.
Your path led through the sea,
Your way through the mighty waters,
but Your footprints were not to be found.
You led Your people like a flock
by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

pictures.scene: Willem Bastiaan Tholen, Zeegezicht met vissersschuiten — the fishing boats out on the open grey water, Selah, the waters saw You O God
pictures.name: pd_tholen_zeegezicht_vissersschuiten

pictures.scene: August Strindberg, Uvejr i skærgården — the sea torn white among the rocks as the weather comes over, the waters saw You and swirled, even the depths were shaken
pictures.name: pd_strindberg_uvejr_i_skaergaarden

pictures.scene: Abraham Teerlink, Cascatelle bij Tivoli met opkomend onweer — the falls going down the rock while the storm breaks above them, the clouds poured down water, the skies resounded with thunder
pictures.name: pd_teerlink_cascatelle_tivoli_onweer

pictures.scene: Wojciech Kossak, Battery on fire, Raszyn — the horse battery brought up at the gallop with its gun through the smoke, Your arrows flashed back and forth, Your thunder resounded in the whirlwind
pictures.name: pd_kossak_battery_on_fire_raszyn

pictures.scene: Evelyn De Morgan, The Storm Spirits — the spirits of the storm bent over the world they are tearing at, the lightning lit up the world, the earth trembled and quaked

pictures.scene: Ludolf Bakhuizen, Woelige zee met schepen — the ships carried over the heavy sea with the swell running under them, Your path led through the sea, Your way through the mighty waters

pictures.scene: Anton Mauve, Herderin met kudde schapen — the shepherdess bringing the whole flock on over the open ground, but Your footprints were not to be found, You led Your people like a flock
pictures.name: pd_mauve_herderin_met_kudde_schapen

pictures.scene: Pieter Gaal, Mozes met de tafelen der wet — Moses holding up the two tables of the law he was given on the mountain, by the hand of Moses and Aaron
